title: Isolated Rectal Bleeding in Newborns : Allergic Proctocolitis or Neonatal Colitis Transient - COLON Study
official: Isolated Rectal Bleeding in Newborns : Allergic Proctocolitis or Neonatal Colitis Transient - COLON Study
summary: Prospective observational pilot study evaluating the frequency of cow's milk protein allergic prococolitis in newborns hospitalized in neontal medicine at the university hospital of Nice who presented rectal bleeding.
